question: Can two typed finite probability kernels be composed without concealing the middle interface or an unproved dependence premise?
level: external exact finite research; no native admission
objects: Three distinct named two-state spaces A,B,C; prior p; row-stochastic K:A->B and L:B->C; declared second prior q; full ordered history

premise: Markov extension is the explicit factorization J[a,b,c]=p[a]*K[a,b]*L[b,c]. Conditional-independence language is restricted to positive conditioning mass. Adjacent laws alone do not imply factorization.
